property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown at the top of the card

property.name: assetLookupField
property.label: Asset Lookup Field API Name
property.description: API name of the field on this record that holds the Asset ID (e.g. AssetId, Asset__c)

property.name: showLastService
property.label: Show Last Service
property.description: Date of the most recent completed or closed work order on the asset or its components

property.name: insightsTitle
property.label: Insights Panel Title
property.description: Heading shown on the insights panel, e.g. Appliance Insights.

property.name: insightsFieldApiName
property.label: Asset Insights Field API Name
property.description: API name of a field on the Asset object whose value is shown as the insights text (e.g. Asset_Insights__c). Leave blank to use the default status-based text.

property.name: insightsPromptTemplate
property.label: Asset Insights Prompt Template API Name
property.description: Flex prompt template (inputs: Asset, AsOfDate) that generates the insights text. Leave blank to use the insights field / status-based text.

property.name: insightTemplates
property.label: Insight Prompt Templates (switchable)
property.description: Comma-separated list of Flex prompt templates shown as tabs in the insights panel, format ApiName:Label (e.g. Asset_Insights:Insights, Asset_Root_Cause_Analysis:Root Cause). Overrides the single template above.

property.name: defaultInsightTemplate
property.label: Default Insight Template
property.description: API name of the template tab selected first (e.g. Asset_Spare_Parts_Recommendation). Blank = first in the list.

property.name: faultCodeField
property.label: Work Order Fault Code Field API Name
property.description: Optional WorkOrder field holding a fault/symptom code. Used to group fleet history (jobs and parts per fault code) in the AI grounding.

property.name: partsSelectionTemplate
property.label: Parts Selection Tab (template API name)
property.description: Prompt template whose tab also shows a selectable spare-parts list with an Add to work order button (work orders only), e.g. Asset_Spare_Parts_Recommendation.

property.name: partsMinProbability
property.label: Parts: Minimum Probability (%)
property.description: Minimum share of similar repairs that used a part before it is listed as Also check.

property.name: laborProductCode
property.label: Labour Product Code
property.description: ProductCode of a labour/service product offered with the parts (e.g. L-1000). Leave blank to hide.

property.name: priceCurrency
property.label: Parts: Price Currency
property.description: ISO currency code for part prices (e.g. SEK). Leave blank to use the work order currency.

property.name: warrantyTermCodes
property.label: Warranty Term Codes
property.description: Comma-separated Warranty Term codes that decide the Warranty Status (e.g. MFR-24). Leave blank to consider all asset warranties.

property.name: insightsMaxHeight
property.label: Insights Panel Max Height (px)
property.description: Height after which the insights/predictions area scrolls internally (header and tabs stay fixed). 0 = no limit.

property.name: asOfDate
property.label: As-Of Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
property.description: Date treated as today for warranty status and insights. Leave blank to use today.

property.name: promptTemplateLabel
property.label: Prompt Template Panel Label
property.description: Label shown in the prompt template panel header

property.name: promptTemplate
property.label: Prompt Template
property.description: Template text for the AI prompt. Supports merge tokens: {assetName} {serialNumber} {status} {location} {installDate} {account}. Example: 'Inspect {assetName} (S/N: {serialNumber}), currently {status} at {location}. Installed: {installDate}.'

property.name: showMapButton
property.label: Show Map Button
property.description: Show a location icon button in the header to open the asset map

property.name: mapAddressField
property.label: Map Address Field API Name (single-field, optional)
property.description: Optional. API name of a single parent field holding a full address string. If set, it overrides the compound address fields below. Leave blank to use Street/City/State/PostalCode/Country.

property.name: mapStreetField
property.label: Map Street Field API Name
property.description: Parent record field for the street part of the map address (default: Street)

property.name: mapCityField
property.label: Map City Field API Name
property.description: Parent record field for the city part of the map address (default: City)

property.name: mapStateField
property.label: Map State Field API Name
property.description: Parent record field for the state/province part of the map address (default: State)

property.name: mapPostalCodeField
property.label: Map Postal Code Field API Name
property.description: Parent record field for the postal code part of the map address (default: PostalCode)

property.name: mapCountryField
property.label: Map Country Field API Name
property.description: Parent record field for the country part of the map address (default: Country)

property.name: flowApiName
property.label: Flow API Name
property.description: API name of a Flow to run from the Actions menu. Leave blank to hide the Flow action.

property.name: flowMenuLabel
property.label: Flow Action Label
property.description: Label shown for the Flow item in the Actions menu

property.name: flowInputVariableName
property.label: Flow Input Variable Name
property.description: Name of the Flow input variable that will receive the Asset record ID
